item.title: Use ConfigMaps and Secrets
item.description: In this tutorial you design a MySQL Pod that takes its database name from a ConfigMap and its root password from a Secret, deploy it to a cluster, and prove from inside the container that each value arrived. Separating configuration and credentials from the container image is how one image runs unchanged in every environment, and knowing exactly how Kubernetes delivers those values tells you why a changed setting sometimes reaches a running container and sometimes does not.
